About
WHO WE ARE
About Amity Coding Club

Fostering innovation and technical excellence through collaborative learning, practical projects, and community building for the next generation of developers.

Our Mission

The Amity Coding Club was born from a simple yet powerful idea: students should never be left behind in the rapidly evolving world of technology. We believe that quality coding education and collaborative learning can transform how people approach programming and problem-solving.

Our platform empowers students to learn together, work on real-world projects, and receive mentorship that helps them grow both technically and professionally. We're building a community where innovation thrives and every member can reach their full potential.

Community First
Connecting students through shared knowledge and collaborative projects
From the Cabin of HOI

A message from our Head of Institution. At Amity Coding Club, we believe that innovation and collaboration are the cornerstones of success in today's fast-evolving tech world. The Head of Institution encourages every student to explore, learn, and create without limits, fostering a culture where ideas turn into impactful solutions.

Upcoming2 Sept 2026 · 9:15 AM
Internal SIH Hackathon 2026

E Block Seminar Hall, Amity University Madhya Pradesh — "Code the Future, Shape the Nation."

🇮🇳 Smart India Hackathon 2026 🇮🇳

A National-Level Hackathon recognized by the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The Internal SIH Hackathon is your first step toward that national stage — and this is your chance to step up. 🚀

💡 WHY SHOULD YOU PARTICIPATE?
  • ✅Real Problems — Solve actual challenges faced by industries, government bodies & society.
  • ✅Real Experience — Build, deploy & present solutions that go beyond textbook projects.
  • ✅Real Exposure — Compete, collaborate and experience what it takes to reach the national level.
  • ✅Real Growth — Win or lose, you'll gain skills that no classroom can teach.
🚀 Don't just learn tech. Build with it.
Completed2–4 June
ACCelerate '26 — Gen AI Bootcamp

A 3-day, 3-mission bootcamp open to all colleges, covering prompt engineering, RAG & system design, and a final build battle.

3 Days. 3 Missions. Infinite Possibilities. 🚀🔥

From prompts to prototypes, from ideas to battles — Accelerate '26 is where builders, creators, and innovators level up together.

Get ready to learn, build, compete, and accelerate beyond limits. ⚡

Amity University Madhya Pradesh
2–4 June 2026

Achievements
WINS THAT SPEAK
Our Achievements

Milestones and recognitions earned by ACC members across hackathons, competitions, and community initiatives.

Amity Coding Club is proud to announce its collaboration with .xyz Domains as an in-kind sponsor for Zynk 1.0, presented in association with the Institution's Innovation Council, MHRD's Innovation Cell (Govt. of India), and IEEE. This partnership reflects growing industry recognition of ACC's initiatives and its commitment to delivering high-quality technical events for the student community.
Amity Coding Club has successfully collaborated with Google Developer Group (GDG) Gwalior to bring industry-relevant learning experiences to our members, strengthening our ties with the broader developer community.
